verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document inspecting past execution logs or manually re-running a failed execution from its failing step. The closest material is adjacent: automatic per-step retries with a delay and attempt limit, generic checkpointing and fault tolerance in workflows-as-code, and error/recovery handlers on schedules. None of these is an ops-driven re-run of a past failed run that resumes at the failing step, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
